purpose: Distinguish learned identity-conditioned reliability from a scope confound: the preregistered unconditional scalar control acts on all public columns, while native reliability acts only on the human-clicked column.
uniform_diagnostic: All eight sequences, C0, P0, target native_discount=0 only after the human click. No grid search, no checkpoint fitting, no GT at runtime.
additional_measurement: Replay each already frozen native-only policy exactly; verify original MOT SHA and record normalization OOD frequency on actual native-active features against its six-fit P1 reliability model.
